narratives.Overview:
# Leftover pending must not max-win ceremony size over a live active brief

Leftover of #4783 after blocking pain-audit 5735653834, retraction 5735725849, and Handoff 5735728714. Operator confirmed the leftover split on 2026-09-18. Do not ingest #4783 as ceremony-dial closed.

## Summary

session:start fills resolved taskSize from max stamped clauseCount across xbrief/{active,pending} (readStampedClauseCount). The fill is consumer evidence merged as explicit-before-provisional, not estimateProvisionalCeremonyInputs.

Leftover pending with no active is the locked #3358 proxy so evaluation is not permanently insufficient evidence. A larger leftover pending can also beat a smaller live active (count > best.count; active scanned first so equal counts keep active).

The issue Expected (activated scope or explicit operator task) cannot bind without a named replacement consumer source. Dropping pending from LIFECYCLE_DIRS with no --task-size/env leaves size=- on a leftover-pending-only consumer and restores the #3358 decline.

## Measured (dispatch-sha f33b8b8e24c9746d02f66532bd1815271771e969)

- packages/core/src/session/ceremony-dial-evidence.ts: LIFECYCLE_DIRS = [active, pending]. readStampedClauseCount max-wins. Source is recorded as xbrief/<dir>/<name>.
- packages/core/src/session/session-start.ts: collectCeremonyDialConsumerEvidence then merge into ceremonyDialInputs before resolveSessionCeremonyDialInputs.
- packages/cli/src/session-start.ts: unflagged deft session:start does not pass verb/prompt size hints. Occupancy runs after dial.
- Tests: pending-only 3 clauses maps to taskSize=M; pending-4 beats active-1 maps to L; explicit CLI size still wins.

## Desired shape

- When an active brief has a stamped clause count, pending must not max-win over it.
- Keep pending as a consumer size source when there is no active brief (#3358), unless a replacement channel is named in the same change (--task-size / env already exist; occupancy-claimed scope is not an input today).
- Name the fill site as consumer-evidence merge, not the provisional classifier.
- CLI --task-size / DEFT_CEREMONY_TASK_SIZE / DEFT_TASK_SIZE still win.
- Tests: leftover pending-only still fills; pending-4 must not beat active-1; no-evidence path still rapid / insufficient evidence.

## Out of scope

- Editing estimateProvisionalCeremonyInputs as if it scanned pending (it does not).
- Binding activated-scope-or-explicit-operator-task as a restore of current contract with no replacement source.
- Changing the rapid default when no evidence exists (#3358 forbid).

Related: #4783, #3358, #3323, #3214, #3263.

## Gate stamp

P1 is pending beating a smaller live active. Keep pending as #3358 proxy when there is no active brief, unless a replacement channel is named. Fill site is consumer-evidence merge, not estimateProvisionalCeremonyInputs. Leftover of #4783.

Pin-read at dispatch-sha 8b4be69db9dae571c72eb9dd8e2ebd49b601cf94: ceremony-dial-evidence.ts LIFECYCLE_DIRS and readStampedClauseCount. Inventory: #3358, #3323, #3214. No implement and no ingest from this parent.

Charter: refutation of Stop 1 comment 5736647230.
Ceiling honored (inclusive id 5736647230). Pin-read `git show 8b4be69db9dae571c72eb9dd8e2ebd49b601cf94:packages/core/src/session/ceremony-dial-evidence.ts` plus session-start merge, ceremony-dial provisional fill, and CLI `--task-size`. Reproduced `readStampedClauseCount` against temp fixtures (same `LIFECYCLE_DIRS`, `count > best.count`, `clauseCountFromBrief`).

## Verdict

The named premise holds. Pending can max-win `clauseCount` over a smaller stamped active. I could not refute it.

`LIFECYCLE_DIRS` is `["active", "pending"]`. `readStampedClauseCount` replaces `best` when `best === null || count > best.count`. Consumer evidence is merged into session inputs with `explicit?.taskSize ?? evidence.taskSize` before `resolveSessionCeremonyDialInputs`. Unflagged CLI `session:start` passes `taskSize: null`, so evidence fills. `estimateProvisionalCeremonyInputs` does not scan pending.

Measured:

- active clauses=1 then pending clauses=4 → `best.count=4` source `xbrief/pending/hard.xbrief.json` (matches locked test "takes the max stamped count across briefs").
- equal counts (2 vs 2) keep the active source (`>` is not `>=`; active-first scan is only a tie-break).
- This dest at the dispatch SHA: pending empty; leftover-complete active `#4744` derives count=5. No pending max-win here.

## Finding 1 — unstamped-active fallthrough is unbound

class: sharpens-framing

Evidence: same scanner, active file with `clauses: []` (no `clause_count`) returns `null` and is skipped; pending-4 then becomes `best`. Desired bullet 1 is stamp-gated ("when an active brief has a stamped clause count"). Desired bullet 2 keeps pending "when there is no active brief". The suite test named "uses pending when active has no clauses" writes only a pending file. Reachable state: active file present, derived count null, pending stamped.

Failure mode: two implementations both pass the three Desired tests. (A) skip pending whenever `xbrief/active/` has a `*.xbrief.json`. (B) skip pending only when some active yields a non-null `clauseCountFromBrief`. (A) drops the `#3358` pending-only proxy as soon as a stub active exists. (B) still lets leftover pending set `taskSize` beside a live unstamped active.

Disposition: the successor lean must pick the gate. Stamp-gated (B) matches P1 as "pending beating a smaller counted active." File-gated (A) is a wider recut and must be named if chosen. Do not treat the misnamed test as coverage of (A) or of the stub-active case.

## Finding 2 — "live active" is folder+count, not occupancy or `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE`

class: sharpens-framing

Evidence: `collectCeremonyDialConsumerEvidence` runs in `session-start.ts` before `runOccupancy(..., write:false)`. Occupancy is not a `CeremonyDialInputs` field. `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE` is the write-fence / spawn pin (`packages/core/src/hooks/scope.ts`); ceremony-dial evidence does not read it. Intra-active max-win already exists: two stamped actives still use `count > best.count` among files in `active/`. Issue Out of scope already refuses restoring "activated scope or explicit operator task" with no replacement source.

Failure mode: an implementer treats "live" as occupancy-claimed scope or `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE` and mints a size channel this leftover forbids. Or they leave "the" active underspecified under WIP>1, so pending-vs-max(active) is shipped as if it selected the occupant.

Disposition: bind "live" as `xbrief/active/*.xbrief.json` with a non-null derived count (max among those files if several). Occupancy / `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE` stay out. Intra-active max-win stays unless a later leftover names a pin.

## Finding 3 — fill site and env/CLI still win

class: footnote

Evidence: `mergeCeremonyDialInputsWithConsumerEvidence` then `mergeCeremonyDialInputsWithProvisional`; CLI `--task-size` / `DEFT_CEREMONY_TASK_SIZE` / `DEFT_TASK_SIZE` remain explicit/env winners. Parent issue `#4783` labeled the field line `provisional:`; reasons for clauseCount live on `[deft ceremony-dial] evidence:`. `DEFT_FAILING_GATE_COUNT` still `maxSize`s over the clause-derived band after any pending/active recut (`collectCeremonyDialConsumerEvidence` keeps the larger of clause size and failing-gate size).

Failure mode: editing `estimateProvisionalCeremonyInputs` as if it scanned pending, or folding failing-gate into P1.

Disposition: keep fill-site and CLI/env bullets as written. Do not treat failing-gate escalation as this leftover.

## Injection / swarm

Triggered: shared `xbrief/{active,pending}` state sets ceremony depth (`skipFatPath`, `autoDeferSteps`, `lifecycleWrites`) on unflagged `session:start`.

The recut is a directory-priority rule, not an identity pin. After bind, a leftover stamped active is the size authority (this dest's leftover-complete `#4744` would already bind count=5 with empty pending). That residual is what Out of scope already accepted. Pending-only leftover still fills (`#3358` keep). No occupancy interlock exists on this path; do not invent one here.

## Road not taken

I tried to refute the premise by (1) occupancy later overriding size, and (2) the provisional classifier being the fill site. Both fail at this SHA.

Steelmanning "max-win is the `#3358` feature, close this leftover": `#3358` needed a consumer proxy so evaluation is not permanently `size=-`. The locked test is max across WIP dirs. Recutting pending-below-stamped-active still keeps pending-only. That steelman does not make the scan false. It would relabel bug vs recut. Desired already names the test rewrite, so I do not block on the lock existing.

What would flip Finding 1 to blocking: Desired tests that still pass under both gates after bind, with no recorded pick.

No `blocks-the-design` finding. Premise stands. Lean can bind once Finding 1's gate and Finding 2's "live" meaning are stated.

## Finding 1 — stamp-gated skip stops the P1 fill

class: footnote

Evidence: Stop 1 P1 is pending beating a smaller live active. Desired bullet 1 is stamp-gated ("when an active brief has a stamped clause count"). OS-temp current scan: active clauses=1 then pending clauses=4 → count=4 source `xbrief/pending/hard.xbrief.json` taskSize=L (matches locked test "takes the max stamped count across briefs"). Stamp-gated skip → count=1 source active taskSize=S. Harvest item 1 plus test "pending-4 must not beat active-1" is that recut.

Pending-only-3 still fills M under stamp-gated (harvest item 3, #3358 keep). Unstamped-active (`clauses: []`) plus pending-4 still fills from pending (harvest item 4 records that remainder). Equal counts 2 vs 2 keep active (`>` is not `>=`). Dest at this SHA: pending empty; leftover-complete `#4744` derives count=5; no pending max-win here.

`estimateProvisionalCeremonyInputs` fills from env/verb/fileCount, not pending. CLI `--task-size` still wins at `mergeCeremonyDialInputsWithConsumerEvidence`. Read `evaluateBoundRemedyCites`: a `relieves` cite is ok only when P1 is in `coveredIds`. This audit puts P1 there.

Failure mode: treating dest empty-pending as "P1 already gone" would skip the locked pending-4/active-1 rewrite. The harvest names the test.

Disposition: bind map stays bindable. No harvest change. Footnote-only is not clearance.

## Injection / swarm

Triggered: shared `xbrief/{active,pending}` sets ceremony depth on unflagged `session:start`. After bind, a stamped active is size authority; leftover pending cannot raise it. Pending-only leftover still fills (#3358 keep on this remainder). Occupancy / `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE` stay out.

## Road not taken

Rejected: treat unstamped-active fallthrough as a P1 miss (Stop 1 "live active" / "no active brief"). Steelman: any file in `active/` is live, so stamp-gated still emits pending size beside a stub active. What would flip: Stop 1 P1 being "pending fills while any active file exists" rather than "pending beating a smaller counted active." Stop 1 uses "smaller"; Desired bullet 1 is stamp-gated; the lean recorded the stub-active case as remainder. That is not this P1.

Rejected: `#4783`-style false `relieves` because harvest keeps pending-only. That was P1 on the parent issue. This leftover's denominator is the beating-active half.

No `blocks-the-design`. No harvest-changing `sharpens-framing`.
